decisions.reason: As the flagship with high visible commitment and central to the firm's announced direction, escalation of commitment makes dropping highly unlikely even if results disappoint.
Having its own page and a positive customer reference signals visible commitment and traction, so management will persist rather than write off that investment.
Only mentioned on the website with little public commitment, but because it builds on the established offer and shows no clear failure, escalation still favors keeping.

Close to the existing offer with little investment and no public commitment, weak visibility after four years makes results hard to attribute to temporary causes, so dropping releases resources without large write-offs.
Security-related and building on the established offer, but with only low public commitment, escalation mildly favors keeping despite limited visibility.
